description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.
